_about: Hibiki Suminami (161183, psychic_teleport_playable): translated from the game's Japanese. Global names/terms: Hibiki Suminami, Luciada, Dia, Regis, Toria, Seiji Takamori (Mr. Takamori), Alk (Nagihara-senpai), Nao, Yuki, Shota, Stella, Magia Fest, Binary Planet, Qualia City, Bionics, Paradise Isle, the House of Sextan, the Farlands, Palpebra, the Purgers. Own: Song of the World (世界の歌, her skill's buff, in the unique condition table), Doyomosu (どよもす).
profile: Hibiki Suminami. A psychic of teleportation. She loves music and pours her many feelings into her songs. She was once tormented by severe anxiety, but recovered after a certain major incident. Now she is helping rebuild Shibuya while earnestly facing this foreign land.
titleCondition: Level Hibiki Suminami to 100 and obtain her Amity Scroll

speech.home/hoshiminomachinooto: The sounds of Starview Village are nice, aren't they? Lively, but clear and calm... I really love them.
speech.home/shiyodewa: I try not to use my power much for personal things. It'd be bad if I were too tired to use it when it counted... and I feel like I'd miss all kinds of things, like the little changes in the seasons.
speech.home/anohino_magia: That day... I'll never forget Magia Fest as long as I live. A lot happened... but all of it is my treasure.
speech.home/watashi_yokubari: It seems I was greedy. Before, just making songs was enough, but now I've started wanting to get them out to everyone.
speech.home/watashinokyokuo: When people say they like my songs, I'm so, so happy...! ...But Luciada's and Toria's offers are on such a different scale that, honestly, they scare me a little...
speech.home/nn_funfun: Mm~♪ Hmm hmm~~... ♪ --Wah!? S-sorry!? Whenever I let my guard down, I start humming...! ...S-so embarrassing... I want to disappear...
speech.ally/join: Things are hard for everyone right now... but there must be feelings only music can convey. --I look forward to working with you all over again...!
speech.ally/evolution: I'm so glad I could tell everyone "thank you". From now on too, I want to weave the same future together with everyone...!

1.title: Days That Go On Past the End
1.summary: Though the Purgers were driven back, Palpebra and Shibuya suffered enormous damage. While continuing the rebuilding and waiting for Nao and the others, Hibiki rejoices at the news of victory. Then, hoping to lighten the hearts of anxious people even a little, Hibiki resolves to write a new song.

lines.5: --That day. A being like an angel descending from the sky burned our town.
lines.17: Big brother... Nao's fighting too. So I'm not gonna cry anymore.
lines.20: --Instead, next time I see you, I'm gonna smack you, so be ready...!
lines.33: Yeah. This time, we're going to go save Ayumu and the others. That's what we need it for.
lines.38: It's a battleship that runs on tech from all kinds of worlds plus dragon power... They say we can't build it without pushing ourselves.
lines.43: You might think, what are we saying, in a situation this bad.
lines.46: But please! Lend us a hand...!!
lines.50: And so, three months after construction began, the finished dragon battleship set sail. A few days later--
lines.55: Word came that a great battle had been won.
lines.59: ...But it doesn't mean everything gets solved and it's all over, like in a movie.
lines.62: Our days go on, today too--
lines.73: Are these all the rebuilding materials for today? I can still fly a little more...
lines.78: That's plenty. Thank you, Ms. Suminami.
lines.82: That's amazing, Suminami... It'd take days to haul all that normally...
lines.87: She was a huge help when we built the ship, too. She carried tons of materials.
lines.92: Thanks to her, the rebuilding looks like it'll finish sooner than first estimated. It's truly a big help.
lines.98: ...No. My power tires me out so quickly, it's frustrating...
lines.103: Nah, nah, resting is part of the job. If you end up all beat up like Ayumu, that's seriously bad, y'know?
lines.107: I mean, you're totally right... but that's kind of hard for me to agree with...?
lines.110: Suminami, good woooork! We'll take it from here. You go rest for today!
lines.113: Oh, no...! I can still wor--
lines.116: Let's go, guys! Hype it up!!
lines.120: Still, y'know... Can't they put barriers on the buildings or somethin'? It ain't funny if they get wrecked again~?
lines.122: Eh, we'll deal with it when it happens~. Next time, let's remodel it into a mega-strong Super Shibuya~!
lines.125: ......Everyone really does have things on their minds, don't they.
lines.128: Right in the middle of barely getting back on our feet in another world, we got attacked like that again... Everyone's laughing now, celebrating the win, but...
lines.132: ...Just like Magia Fest. They're laughing to hide their anxiety...
lines.141: S-sorry...! I didn't mean to say anything about you, Nagihara...!
lines.145: Nah, it's fine. I know. Actually, I was thinking you really are the one who made Binary Planet.
lines.152: ...Um... ......Nagihara, is your body all right now...?
lines.156: Yeah, my body's fine now. It's just one eye that's done for. Honestly I could even do heavy lifting.
lines.165: Yeah. I think I probably do.
lines.167: But there's also stuff I don't regret way more than that. ...Probably?
lines.178: Nao came to see me the other day. She said she wouldn't be able to see me for a while because of the expedition team.
lines.180: ...I thought she was amazing. She keeps moving forward.
lines.183: Mr. Takamori. Nagihara. I want to try harder.
lines.186: I've already been saved. This time, I want to be the one who saves others.
lines.191: ...Yes. But in that case, there may be a different way than Nagihara and the others'.
lines.193: I'm sure you have your own way, Ms. Suminami.
lines.202: I want to write a new song.
lines.206: And if I can... I hope it can lighten everyone's anxiety, even just a little...
lines.211: Yes. I'm sure it can. That certainly is your way, isn't it?
lines.221: Then you will need a studio.
lines.230: Wh-what!? This...! Is this really okay!?
lines.234: Well... actually, a certain noble student council president already had all the equipment set up...
lines.238: I'm a little worried that this is one step closer to being kept, but... I'll thank her later.
lines.241: And you too, Nagihara, and everyone. Thank you so much.
lines.249: I think I'll be coming here even more than before. I look forward to working with you all again...!
lines.255: Yes. Welcome to Starview Village, Hibiki.
lines.263: I'm going to write a wonderful song--!

2.title: The Words I Want to Tell You
2.summary: Luciada and the others bring Hibiki, who has fallen into a slight slump, to Qualia City to have fun. Refreshed, Hibiki is faced with the parting that will come with Luciada's graduation. Realizing the feelings she truly wants to convey, she breaks out of her slump and gives Luciada a song.

lines.12: The new song... just doesn't feel right somehow...
lines.17: New song-- Oh, the one Mr. Takamori mentioned. The one to lighten everyone's anxiety...
lines.21: ...Until now, I just had to turn everything I felt straight into sound.
lines.25: But this time, that's not enough. I have to reach everyone, from me--
lines.29: This time, I want to be the one who helps...!
lines.34: Maybe you shouldn't worry about it too much-- ...That's easier said than done, huh.
lines.39: ...Yes... I understand it less and less...
lines.45: This is a grave matter...! A loss for the world. We must take countermeasures at once.
lines.49: Do you have a good idea?
lines.60: Playing to your heart's content and blowing off some steaaaam!!
lines.69: I think that's a good idea. You've been writing songs in between helping with the rebuilding this whole time, right, Suminami?
lines.74: You gotta take a break sometimes. We went to Paradise Isle too! Actually, we're going again this year!!
lines.90: That last game's difficulty is busted, right!? It's impossible even with psychic powers???
lines.94: Told you. That one's made for Bionics people, so it's rough.
lines.98: What are you doing there? Taking pictures with your tablet?
lines.103: No, I recorded all kinds of sounds from the city. Qualia City has lots of interesting sounds.
lines.108: Huh, what? What do you mean??
lines.112: Collecting all kinds of sounds is a hobby of mine.
lines.114: Like people's footsteps, animal cries, the noises from shops at work.
lines.122: When I invited you to the Sextan villa in the summer, you recorded all sorts of sounds then too.
lines.127: Yes. Hardly anyone does it, but it's fun. I can make songs with them, too.
lines.132: Oh! I've seen stuff like this in videos! Wait, isn't this crazy good? It's a real song!
lines.136: If you make a song out of sounds you collected on a trip, you can remember that time, so I recommend it...!
lines.141: That's really nice. I want to try it too, but--
lines.150: U-um...!? Then I'll make them into songs and give them to you later...!?
lines.155: Hehe. Thank you, Hibiki. It'll be a lovely graduation memory.
lines.164: After graduation, will you become a teacher at the Arcane Arts Academy or something?
lines.169: No. I have my family to think of. After graduating, I'll be returning to the Farlands.
lines.178: It'll be lonely not being able to drop by Starview Village casually like now... but it can't be helped.
lines.182: Oh, but I'll definitely rush over for Hibiki and Dia's concerts! You can rest easy on that!
lines.186: I'm not worried about that at all.
lines.200: It's no good after all... I could write so easily during the day...
lines.202: The people of Shibuya... and everyone who invited me out to cheer me up...
lines.206: ...I... can't give anything back to any of them...
lines.211: ......Well...... ...with my power... it's no distance at all...
lines.220: I see... So that's what it was...
lines.230: Oh my! So the new song that was giving you so much trouble is finished...!
lines.246: ............A song I made... for you, Luciada...
lines.249: You've helped me so much, and I've never really paid you back... So... it's a thank-you, sort of...?
lines.252: ...So many people have helped me, you and the people of Shibuya and...
lines.255: When I thought I wanted to repay them, the song came out like all my struggling had been a lie.
lines.258: That I don't want to encourage them, I want to tell them "thank you"... So...
lines.266: Hehe, you're welcome. I'm glad I could be of help to you, Hibiki.
lines.271: Ah! You can't listen to that yet...!
lines.275: ............It's embarrassing, so... ...please listen to it after you go back to the Farlands...
lines.278: ...Um. Give that back to me for now. Just to be safe, I'll give it to you again right before you leave.

3.title: Your Song That Resonates and Weaves
3.summary: Having finished her new song after much struggle, Hibiki visits Regis before the big day. Telling Regis everything she felt while facing her music, Hibiki performs with Dia and makes the show a success. And so, through meetings and partings, she keeps walking through her days.

lines.6: ...Um. This is the new song I was struggling with.
lines.9: U-um...? I'm debuting it at next week's concert, so if you could, any thoughts...
lines.13: Nah, like... that was seriously amazing...
lines.25: It was a life without regrets...!
lines.31: There you go! Way to go, Hibiki!
lines.41: ...Truly splendid. But it's a shame this stage is so makeshift...
lines.45: N-no, not at all...! Just having you prepare a proper place for me is more than enough!
lines.49: Actually, it's a good opportunity. We can't spend all our time on rebuilding work.
lines.51: People need a breather somewhere. Even though it's moving at a rapid pace, the rebuilding will still take time.
lines.55: In that case, we've gotta make next week's show a total success!
lines.69: U-um...! You're Regis, right? Thank you for your time today.
lines.73: I'm Hibiki Suminami. N-nice to meet you.
lines.77: ...It's true this is the first time we've met face to face. But I know you well, Hibiki Suminami.
lines.79: So? What business do you have with me?
lines.83: ...Next week, Dia and I are doing an open-air concert in Shibuya. If you'd like, please come watch.
lines.87: Oh? And why give this to me?
lines.91: Because I want... someone precious to Dia to see the stage we perform on together.
lines.95: I hear this song is meant to encourage the people of Palpebra and Shibuya.
lines.97: With this, you two will become symbols of both cities, in name and in fact.
lines.102: I can't say... that I'm ready for that.
lines.109: --But. Making this song made me realize something.
lines.113: ...I'm sure I'll keep making songs that answer my own feelings and the feelings I've received from everyone.
lines.120: I don't know yet whether that's a good thing or a bad thing. I'm sure I'll regret plenty.
lines.122: ...But I'm sure I'll feel glad I did it even more than that.
lines.126: That's how I want to live-- resonating with everyone, and with the world.
lines.139: ...It seems you're far more self-confident than I thought?
lines.143: S-sorry...! I talked like I'd definitely succeed... ...So embarrassing...!!
lines.155: After all, I already have one.
lines.159: But if you're going to speak of the future, hold your head a little higher. So that you're worthy of standing beside my songstress.
lines.169: ...Good grief. I wanted to keep her as a hated rival, but nothing goes the way I expect.
lines.188: Hehe, me too...! I had so much fun playing...!
lines.195: Good work~! That concert just now was so... so wonderful~...!!
lines.197: Woohoo! Seriously!! It was seeeeriously the best!!
lines.199: No... really...... for real for real... ...thank you, or like... yeah... ......*sniff*...
lines.201: H-hey, boss! Don't cry! If you do that... then we'll...!
lines.207: N-no... I should be the one...!
lines.215: See? Didn't I tell you before? ...Your songs, Hibiki, are the kind that stay close to people.
lines.219: The song you gave me the other day. And today's concert too...!
lines.231: How do you know what kind of song I gave you...?
lines.234: I told you, didn't I? After you got back to the Farlands.
lines.246: Ugh, honestly...! You've kind of ruined everything...!
lines.251: S-sorry...! But I was really, truly so happy, I just...!!
lines.259: --I heard the great battle was over. But our days will go on from here.
lines.262: Meeting and parting along the way. Dreaming of the same future, holding hands--

5000656/1.19:
A lakeside villa built at a highland summer retreat on the outskirts of the Sextan domain in the Kingdom of the Farlands.
The scenic views from its windows make one forget the worries of everyday life.
Swimming and boating on the lake mean visitors never get bored.
Rumor has it that last year, a foreign composer and a princess were invited.

5000657/1.19:
An alias used by Hibiki Suminami.
It comes from the word "doyomosu" (to resound), which contains her own name.
It was also used when she released the song Binary Planet on a video site.

However, since Magia Fest, Hibiki Suminami has mainly been active under her real name, and this alias seems to be limited to private accounts and the like.
